import json, itertools
rules = []
# ---- parse ----
rules.append([r"^(\S+) w (\S+) (\S+) .*$", r"\1 \2 \3"])
rules.append([r"([a-h])[36]$", r"\1"])
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    rules.append([str(d), "." * d])
rules.append(["/", ""])
for combo in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=4):
    s = "".join(c for c, b in zip("KQkq", combo) if b) or "-"
    fixed = "".join(c if b else "-" for c, b in zip("KQkq", combo))
    rules.append([r"^(.{64}) " + s + r" (.)$", r"O:\g<1>" + fixed + r"\g<2>"])
# body: 0..63 board, 64..67 castling, 68 ep
EP = 68
def look(cons):
    s, prev = "", -1
    for i in sorted(cons):
        g = i - prev - 1
        if g: s += ".{%d}" % g
        s += cons[i]
        prev = i
    return "(?=" + s + ")"
def gen(prefix_in, prefix_out, cons, mods):
    pat = "(?m)^" + prefix_in + ":" + look(cons)
    rep = r"\g<0>" + "\n" + prefix_out + ":"
    prev, gi = -1, 0
    for i in sorted(mods):
        g = i - prev - 1
        if g:
            gi += 1
            pat += "(.{%d})" % g
            rep += r"\g<%d>" % gi
        pat += "."
        rep += mods[i]
        prev = i
    gi += 1
    pat += "(.*)$"
    rep += r"\g<%d>" % gi
    rules.append([pat, rep])
EMPTY, BLACK, TGT = r"\.", "[pnbrq]", "[.pnbrq]"
def rc(i): return divmod(i, 8)
def sq(r, c): return r * 8 + c
def onb(r, c): return 0 <= r < 8 and 0 <= c < 8
def castle_mods(piece, f, t, mods):
    if piece == "K":
        mods[64] = "-"; mods[65] = "-"
    if piece == "R" and f == 63: mods[64] = "-"
    if piece == "R" and f == 56: mods[65] = "-"
    if t == 7: mods[66] = "-"
    if t == 0: mods[67] = "-"
KN = [(1,2),(2,1),(-1,2),(-2,1),(1,-2),(2,-1),(-1,-2),(-2,-1)]
KG = [(a,b) for a in (-1,0,1) for b in (-1,0,1) if (a,b)!=(0,0)]
ORTH = [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
DIAG = [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]
for f in range(64):
    r, c = rc(f)
    for piece, dirs, slide in [("N",KN,False),("K",KG,False),("B",DIAG,True),("R",ORTH,True),("Q",ORTH+DIAG,True)]:
        for dr, dc in dirs:
            path = []
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            while onb(rr, cc):
                t = sq(rr, cc)
                cons = {f: piece, t: TGT}
                for p in path: cons[p] = EMPTY
                mods = {f: ".", t: piece, EP: "-"}
                castle_mods(piece, f, t, mods)
                gen("O", "M", cons, mods)
                if not slide: break
                path.append(t)
                rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
    # pawns
    if 1 <= r <= 6:
        np = "Q" if r == 1 else "P"
        t = f - 8
        gen("O", "M", {f: "P", t: EMPTY}, {f: ".", t: np, EP: "-"})
        if r == 6:
            t2 = f - 16
            gen("O", "M", {f: "P", t: EMPTY, t2: EMPTY}, {f: ".", t2: "P", EP: "abcdefgh"[c]})
        for dc in (-1, 1):
            if not onb(r - 1, c + dc): continue
            t = sq(r - 1, c + dc)
            mods = {f: ".", t: np, EP: "-"}
            castle_mods("P", f, t, mods)
            gen("O", "M", {f: "P", t: BLACK}, mods)
            if r == 3:
                gen("O", "M", {f: "P", t: EMPTY, t + 8: "p", EP: "abcdefgh"[c + dc]},
                    {f: ".", t: "P", t + 8: ".", EP: "-"})
# castling
gen("O", "K", {64: "K", 60: "K", 61: EMPTY, 62: EMPTY, 63: "R"},
    {61: "K", 62: "K", 64: "-", 65: "-", EP: "-"})
gen("O", "Q", {65: "Q", 60: "K", 59: EMPTY, 58: EMPTY, 57: EMPTY, 56: "R"},
    {59: "K", 58: "K", 64: "-", 65: "-", EP: "-"})
rules.append([r"(?m)^O:[^\n]*\n?", ""])
# ---- legality filter ----
for k in range(64):
    r, c = rc(k)
    alts = []
    def a(cons): alts.append(look(cons))
    for dr, dc in KN:
        if onb(r+dr, c+dc): a({sq(r+dr, c+dc): "n"})
    for dr, dc in KG:
        if onb(r+dr, c+dc): a({sq(r+dr, c+dc): "k"})
    for dc in (-1, 1):
        if onb(r-1, c+dc): a({sq(r-1, c+dc): "p"})
    for dirs, cls in [(ORTH, "[rq]"), (DIAG, "[bq]")]:
        for dr, dc in dirs:
            path = []
            rr, cc = r+dr, c+dc
            while onb(rr, cc):
                s = sq(rr, cc)
                cons = {s: cls}
                for p in path: cons[p] = EMPTY
                a(cons)
                path.append(s)
                rr, cc = rr+dr, cc+dc
    rules.append(["(?m)^[MKQ]:" + look({k: "K"}) + "(?:" + "|".join(alts) + ")[^\\n]*\\n?", ""])
# castle fixups
def fix(pin, mods):
    pat = "(?m)^" + pin + ":"
    rep = "M:"
    prev, gi = -1, 0
    for i in sorted(mods):
        g = i - prev - 1
        if g:
            gi += 1; pat += "(.{%d})" % g; rep += r"\g<%d>" % gi
        pat += "."; rep += mods[i]; prev = i
    gi += 1; pat += "(.*)$"; rep += r"\g<%d>" % gi
    rules.append([pat, rep])
fix("K", {60: ".", 61: "R", 62: "K", 63: "."})
fix("Q", {56: ".", 58: "K", 59: "R", 60: "."})
# ---- output ----
rules.append([r"(?m)^M:" + "(.{8})" * 8 + r"(.{4})(.)$",
              "/".join(r"\g<%d>" % i for i in range(1, 9)) + r" b \g<9> \g<10>"])
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    rules.append([r"\." * d, str(d)])
for combo in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=4):
    s = "".join(c for c, b in zip("KQkq", combo) if b) or "-"
    fixed = "".join(c if b else "-" for c, b in zip("KQkq", combo))
    rules.append([r"(?m) b " + re_escape if False else r"(?m) b " + fixed.replace("-", r"\-") + " ", " b " + s + " "])
rules.append([r"(?m) ([a-h])$", r" \g<1>3 0 0"])
rules.append([r"(?m) -$", r" - 0 0"])
rules.append([r"\n+\Z", ""])
json.dump(rules, open("/tmp/obench-cell-puhex3l_/bench_opencode_regex-chess_szcik2jm/re.json", "w"))
print(len(rules))
